prompt:
One-field change to the declaratively managed klaus config: set the fleet-default agent model.

In cosmo's home/dev.nix, the attrset rendered to home.file.".klaus/config.json" (around line 131, gated on cosmo.klaus.enable) gains one field: default_agent_model = "opus"; — matching the existing fields' style and ordering convention in that attrset. Do NOT add default_agent_effort; its absence is deliberate (claude's own default applies).

Why (for the PR body): klaus launch now supports --model/--effort with config defaults; until the config pins default_agent_model, every dispatched agent silently inherits the operator's interactive model preference. Pinning "opus" decouples fleet policy from interactive preference; per-dispatch flags tier up or down from it.

Order of work: (1) make the change, commit, push, OPEN THE PR immediately with the body noting "verification in progress"; (2) verify in the foreground: nix build .#nixosConfigurations.classic-laddie.config.system.build.toplevel --no-link — the closure is warm from a build an hour ago, only the home-manager files rebuild, so this is minutes; (3) comment the result on the PR. Do not end the run before step 3.

Conventions: normal PR flow; terse commit message; no Co-Authored-By trailers naming Claude or Anthropic; no mention of AI in commit or PR body.
